item.text:
Created a Rust 2021 Cargo project in `/output` with the root entry file [test20.rs](/output/test20.rs), library wiring in [src/lib.rs](/output/src/lib.rs), and modular inflection logic under [src/inflection/mod.rs](/output/src/inflection/mod.rs) and [src/inflection/transforms.rs](/output/src/inflection/transforms.rs). It uses only `std` and mirrors the observed C++ behavior, including the simplistic string transforms and the `demodulize` abort quirk.

It compiles successfully both ways: `cargo build --release` produced `/output/target/release/test20`, and `rustc --edition=2021 -C panic=abort test20.rs -o test20` produced `/output/test20`. I verified exact stdout/stderr and exit-code matches against `/workspace/dataset/test20_executable` across a broad probe set, including normal cases and the crashing edge cases.
